role: Retrospective secondary analysis of exposed confirmation-v01 recordings. Not new confirmation or a deployable evaluation-label threshold policy.
match_tolerance: Actual FP count spread between a named pair <=max(1, floor(0.01*target_FP_count)), both counts <=target. Report actual counts and attainment. Otherwise not matched; no threshold interpolation or invented fractional detections.
threshold_rule: Initial threshold from floor-output FP confidences with float32 successor. Re-run actual upstream NMS and one-to-one matching at every reported threshold. If actual FP exceeds budget raise threshold using actual FP scores and re-run. Unused budget, ties and floor-limited operating range retained. Retrospective thresholds use the evaluated sequence labels and are diagnostic only.
reference: Original fixed dense Thun threshold defines identity-query evidence denominator at every operating point. Full-GT recall is the primary matched-FP task endpoint. Dense under a changed threshold need not preserve 100% of this reference.
mechanism: Fixed head outputs. Exact original dense TP anchor/site support; four-way residual/activity source coverage versus actual NMS/matching; score-head Spearman by query; padding and GT-center occupancy; signed-overlap identity N=M+B-2O; unsigned residual=sum||H|-|P||/C removes sign opposition, not a retrained detector. Spatial roll preserves historical value distribution but breaks its spatial correspondence. All variants reported; no chosen hybrid.
limits: Four exposed same-city public training clips
Model, representation, resolution and state differ; no intrinsic ANN-vs-SNN causal claim
Only candidate admission; all detector work and state updates executed
No new risk policy, computation saving or safety claim
